evidence:
- cause: `npm view @jdxcode/mise-windows-x64` returns E404 because the package does not exist at all, not only at 2026.10.24. The `mise` npm package (2026.10.24 and 2026.10.25) has `preinstall: node installArchSpecificPackage.js`, which runs `npm install @jdxcode/mise-<platform>-<arch>@<version>`. `@jdxcode/mise-linux-x64` exists with versions through 2026.10.25, which is why Linux works. A version bump cannot fix Windows.
- fix: the windows job's install step uses `--ignore-scripts`. mise-action already puts mise on PATH, `mise run test` needs no lifecycle script, and the tests do not use lefthook or the Claude Code binary. The test step is unchanged and has no skip or continue-on-error, and the job stays.
- gates: ci.yml parses; fmt:check and test pass in the worktree (exit 0). package.json, mise.toml and bun.lock are unchanged, so the Linux job is unchanged.
- checks-run: see checks above.
- changed-paths: /home/user/holyagent-setup-scope/.github/workflows/ci.yml
